title: Tensor summand formula for ordinary evaluation under open reindexing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U$ an open [def-pc-scheme], and $P$ an integer cochain complex on its over-site. Let $L$ be Modules.overEquiv and $T$ its degreewise functor. There exist termwise internal-Hom isomorphisms e, natural under precomposition and postcomposition, with the following compatibility. For every family of chain isomorphisms b as follows, suppose $b(M):T\mathcal{H}om^\bullet(P,M)\cong\mathcal{H}om^\bullet(TP,TM)$ satisfies $b(M)^n;\pi_{TP,TM,n,r,s}=L(\pi_{P,M,n,r,s});e(P^r,M^s)$ for every $r+n=s$, using the specified product projections [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]; no chain-map naturality hypothesis is needed. Let a be the degreewise single-unit comparison formed by singleMapHomologicalComplex and overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso, and set $d=b(O_U[0]);\mathcal{H}om^\bullet(TP,a)$. For every complex F there is an isomorphism $c:T\operatorname{Tot}(F\otimes\mathcal{H}om^\bullet(P,O_U[0]))\cong\operatorname{Tot}(TF\otimes T\mathcal{H}om^\bullet(P,O_U[0]))$. For every chain map f satisfying [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data], set $t=c;\operatorname{Tot}(1\otimes d)$. Then $t^{-1};T(f);b(F)$ satisfies [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-formula]. This concerns ordinary complexes without boundedness or perfectness assumptions.

proof.text: Apply internalHom_overEquiv to obtain the termwise comparison e and its naturality, retaining the witnesses as local terms.

Choose the unit-normalized symmetric monoidal structure and its total tensor summand comparisons. For a supplied b and its projection equations, take the tensor comparison for F and the local Hom dual of P. This c does not depend on f.

Apply the component-transport theorem to this m and this c with their unit, symmetry and summand equations. It gives preservation of the local evaluation predicate for every f. Pair this proof with c to obtain the existential tensor comparison, then pair the result with e and its naturality. These existential witnesses are supplied by independent Hom and tensor constructions, not by restating the original existential assertion.

theorem exists_ordinaryEvaluation_over_tensor_formula (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (P : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ) :
    let L := Equivalence.functor
      (C := localEvaluationModules X U)
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)
    let T := L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let O' := (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)))
    ∃ (e : ∀ A B : localEvaluationModules X U,
        L.obj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf.over U) A B) ≅
          SheafOfModules.homObj (R := U.toScheme.sheaf) (L.obj A) (L.obj B)),
      (∀ (A A' B B' : localEvaluationModules X U) (f : A' ⟶ A) (g : B ⟶ B'),
        L.map (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := X.sheaf.over U) f g) ≫
            (e A' B').hom =
          (e A B).hom ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)
            (L.map f) (L.map g)) ∧
    ∀ (b : ∀ M : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ,
        T.obj (homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) P M) ≅
          homComplex (R := U.toScheme.sheaf) (T.obj P) (T.obj M)),
      (∀ (M : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ)
          (n r s : ℤ) (h : r + n = s),
        (b M).hom.f n ≫
            (Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)))
              (T.obj P) (T.obj M) n r s h =
          L.map (localEvaluationProjection X U P M n r s h) ≫
            (e (P.X r) (M.X s)).hom) →
      let a : T.obj (localEvaluationUnit X U) ≅ O' :=
        (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex L (.up ℤ) 0).app _ ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso
            (Scheme.Modules.overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U).symm
      let d := b (localEvaluationUnit X U) ≪≫
        ((homComplexFunctor (R := U.toScheme.sheaf)).obj (op (T.obj P))).mapIso a
      ∀ F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ,
        ∃ c : T.obj (localEvaluationTensor X U P F) ≅
            pullbackTensorTotal U.toScheme (T.obj F) (T.obj (localEvaluationDual X U P)),
          ∀ f : localEvaluationTensor X U P F ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) P F,
            IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation X U P F f →
              IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation U.toScheme (T.obj P) (T.obj F)
                ((c ≪≫ (((curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u}
                  (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))).map₂CochainComplex).obj
                    (T.obj F)).mapIso d).inv ≫
                  T.map f ≫ (b F).hom)
